services.name: Tree Removal
services.title: Tree Removal in Lehi, UT | Lehi Tree Pros
services.metaDescription: Safe tree removal for dead, damaged, or unwanted trees in Lehi, UT and Utah County. Free estimates, fast scheduling. Call (385) 534-4337.
services.heroDescription: When a tree is dead, leaning, or too close to your house, removal is the safest option. We handle the cut, the drop, and the cleanup.
services.headline: Tree Removal for Lehi Homeowners
services.paragraph1: Not every tree is worth saving, and in Lehi's wind and winter snow load, a dead or weakened tree near a house, driveway, or fence is a real risk. We assess the lean, the root condition, and what's nearby before recommending removal — if trimming or cabling can fix the problem instead, we'll say so.
services.paragraph2: Tight lots are common in newer Lehi neighborhoods, so we plan each removal around what's actually around the tree: power lines, sheds, neighboring fences, gardens. Larger trees come down in sections when there isn't room for a straight drop. Stump removal is available as a separate service if you want the area fully cleared.

faqs.question: How do I know if a tree needs to come down or just needs trimming?
faqs.answer: If more than a quarter of the tree is dead, the trunk has a deep lean or split, or the roots are visibly lifting near the base, removal is usually the safer call. We'll walk the tree with you and explain what we're seeing before recommending anything.

faqs.question: Will removal damage my lawn or driveway?
faqs.answer: We plan the drop zone and use mats or boards under equipment on grass and pavers when needed. For tight spaces, we section the tree down by rope instead of dropping it whole.

faqs.question: Do you remove the stump too?
faqs.answer: We can grind the stump as part of the same visit or schedule it separately — let us know what you'd like when you request your estimate.

services.name: Tree Trimming
services.title: Tree Trimming & Pruning in Lehi, UT | Lehi Tree Pros
services.metaDescription: Professional tree trimming and pruning in Lehi, UT. Improve tree health, safety, and curb appeal. Free estimates — call (385) 534-4337.
services.heroDescription: Regular trimming keeps trees healthy, away from rooflines and power lines, and looking the way you want them to.
services.headline: Tree Trimming in Lehi
services.paragraph1: Trimming does more than tidy things up — it removes weak or crossing branches before they break in a windstorm, opens up airflow so the canopy stays healthy, and keeps limbs away from your roof, siding, and gutters. We cut with the tree's natural shape in mind instead of just hacking back growth.
services.paragraph2: Timing matters too. Some species in Utah County are better pruned in late winter before new growth starts, while others can be trimmed almost any time of year. If you're not sure what your tree needs or when, tell us what you're seeing and we'll give you a straight answer on the call.
bullets: Crown thinning and shaping
Deadwood and hazard branch removal
Clearance trimming from roofs, siding, and power lines
Young tree structural pruning
Fruit and ornamental tree maintenance

faqs.question: How often should trees be trimmed?
faqs.answer: Most established trees do well with trimming every 2-3 years. Fast-growing species, fruit trees, or trees near structures often need it yearly. We can suggest a schedule based on what's on your property.

faqs.question: Can you trim trees that are close to power lines?
faqs.answer: Yes, we regularly trim branches that are approaching utility lines. For lines that are already in contact with a tree, we'll coordinate with the utility company before starting work.

faqs.question: Will trimming hurt my tree?
faqs.answer: Done correctly, no — proper pruning cuts encourage healthy new growth. We avoid over-thinning or topping, which are the two things that actually stress a tree out.

services.name: Stump Grinding
services.title: Stump Grinding in Lehi, UT | Lehi Tree Pros
services.metaDescription: Stump grinding below grade in Lehi, UT. Reclaim your yard after a tree removal. Free estimates — call (385) 534-4337.
services.heroDescription: A leftover stump is a tripping hazard and takes up space you could be using. We grind it below the surface so you can plant grass, build, or just stop mowing around it.
services.headline: Stump Grinding for Lehi Yards
services.paragraph1: Whether we removed the tree or someone else did, we can grind the stump down below grade so it's no longer in the way. Grinding gets through the trunk and major surface roots, leaving wood chips behind that can be removed or left for you to use as mulch.
services.paragraph2: We size the equipment to the job — a single stump near a garden bed is a quick visit, while several stumps from a lot-clearing job take more time. Either way, we work carefully around sprinkler lines, edging, and nearby plantings where you point them out.
bullets: Grinding below ground level for replanting or sod
Multiple stump and lot-clearing jobs
Wood chip cleanup or chips left on request
Careful work around sprinklers, utilities, and landscaping
Free estimates before any work starts

faqs.question: How deep do you grind the stump?
faqs.answer: Typically 4-6 inches below grade, which is enough to plant grass or seed over it. Let us know if you're planning to build over the spot and need it deeper.

faqs.question: What happens to the wood chips?
faqs.answer: We can haul them away or leave them in a pile if you want them for mulch — just let us know which you'd prefer before we start.

faqs.question: Can you grind a stump close to my house or fence?
faqs.answer: In most cases, yes. We'll look at the clearance during your estimate and let you know if anything needs to be done differently.

services.headline: 24/7 Emergency Tree Service in Lehi
services.paragraph1: Utah County storms can bring down limbs and entire trees with little warning, and a tree resting on a roof or blocking a driveway isn't something that can wait until Monday. Call (385) 534-4337 and we'll talk through what you're dealing with and get someone out as soon as we can.
services.paragraph2: Our first priority in an emergency is making the situation safe — securing or removing what's hazardous, clearing access to your home, and getting weight off a structure if a tree has fallen on it. From there we'll talk about full removal, cleanup, and whether you'll need anything for an insurance claim.
bullets: Available 24/7 for storm damage and fallen trees
Trees down on homes, garages, fences, or vehicles
Hazardous hanging limbs after wind or snow

faqs.question: How fast can you get to an emergency?
faqs.answer: Response time depends on the time of day and how many calls are ahead of you, but emergency calls are prioritized over routine scheduling. Call (385) 534-4337 and we'll give you a realistic estimate when you call.

faqs.question: Will you work with my insurance company?
faqs.answer: We can document the damage with photos and provide details about the work for your claim. Filing the claim itself is between you and your insurer.

faqs.question: What should I do while I'm waiting for you to arrive?
faqs.answer: Stay away from the tree and any hanging or broken limbs, especially if power lines are involved. Keep people and pets clear of the area until we get there.
